official_measurement_examples.name: Historic landfill definition
official_measurement_examples.fact: Environment Agency historic landfill data represents known sites where no environmental permit is currently in force.

official_measurement_examples.name: May 2026 update
official_measurement_examples.fact: The national historic landfill dataset was last updated 15 May 2026 and is normally updated every six months.

official_measurement_examples.name: Dataset incompleteness
official_measurement_examples.fact: The historic dataset includes pre-licensing survey material from the early 1990s and may be incomplete.

official_measurement_examples.name: Authorised landfill distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: The authorised landfill layer represents sites currently authorised under environmental permitting and must not be merged with historic landfill status.

official_measurement_examples.name: Permit surrender
official_measurement_examples.fact: A closed or aftercare landfill can remain subject to its environmental permit until the Environment Agency accepts surrender.

official_measurement_examples.name: 17 June 2026 guidance
official_measurement_examples.fact: The landfill aftercare and surrender guidance was updated 17 June 2026 and retains evidence requirements for surrender applications.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Waste planning location decisions and Environment Agency environmental permits are separate controls.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Historic landfill geometry is risk evidence and does not by itself prove contamination extent, remediation status or development capacity on a parcel.

core_rules: historic landfill record is not an active environmental permit
authorised landfill record is not historic landfill status
absence from historic landfill dataset is not proof no historic waste exists
historic landfill geometry is not contamination extent proof
landfill closure is not automatically permit surrender
aftercare status is not unrestricted redevelopment clearance
environmental permit is not planning permission
planning permission is not environmental permit
waste recovery permit is distinct from landfill permit
surrender evidence must retain current regulatory status
historic waste types must retain source and date context
landfill records do not determine land ownership
landfill permit status does not reserve development capacity
dataset update lag must not silently alter legal status
no parcel landfill clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Official Environment Agency, GOV.UK, National Data Library and legislation sources checked on 2026-07-26; active, historic, closure, aftercare and surrender states kept separate.
